author: Insta360
description:
Find out how to film yourself, your life, and more with Insta360 GO Ultra ✨ Whether you're running, cycling, traveling, or just filming a daily diary, this tiny vlog camera can film it all POV style—no crew needed!

Get your Insta360 GO Ultra here 👉https://bit.ly/GOUltraTutorial

Join Rena Gao (@wegofilm) on a daytrip to the beautiful Awaji Island in Japan, and find out how she made it, too, with great tips on how to set up your GO Ultra, record B-roll, and more.

If you're a beginner, a shy vlogger, or someone who wants to start vlogging, this is for you! See the best camera settings, angles to shoot from, and how to use our mounts, sticky tabs, clips, and Magnet Pendant for immersive POV shots.

Insta360 weighs just 53g and can be mounted almost anywhere. It can record 4K60fps videos for up to 200 minutes when using the Action Pod, keep your videos smooth automatically with FlowState Stabilization, has a removable microSD card storage, so you can shoot, fill up a card, swap it out,
title: How to Vlog: Tips for Easy Selfie Vlogs | Insta360 GO Ultra
